about: Values that unailib (Go) and the browser transport (the SDK) must hold equal: each bounds a step that the other end, or the Session code of the wheel above both, is sized on. A test on each side compares its constants with this table; no code reads it at run time. It travels in the wheels, so that the SDK reads the same bytes.

values.name: disconnection_grace
values.step: How long a peer is kept after its last connection closed before the Session is told: a connection that comes back within it is no loss.

values.name: session_frame_send
values.step: The bound of the send of one Session frame (the dial when there is no connection, the stream, the write), awaited by the Session in its tick.

values.name: relay_reservation
values.step: The bound of the request of a slot on a relay, awaited by the join of a world and by the renewal of the slot.

values.name: webrtc_signaling
values.step: The whole budget of the answerer of a WebRTC offer, and of the offerer in the TURN stage.

values.name: webrtc_direct_stage
values.step: The budget of the direct stage of a WebRTC offer (STUN only): the signalling and the opening of the DataChannel together.

values.name: webrtc_stage_pause
values.step: The pause of the offerer between a direct stage that failed and its TURN offer, for a browser answerer to read the abort and let that exchange go.

values.name: webrtc_gather_quiet
values.step: The silence after a candidate of the kind the stage needs that sends the offer or the answer: the SDP is not trickled.

values.name: webrtc_direct_gather_max
values.step: The longest wait for candidates in the direct stage, under the stage budget so that the other end gets the SDP within its own.

values.name: webrtc_turn_gather_max
values.step: The longest wait for candidates in the TURN stage and in an offer with the whole server list.

values.name: webrtc_freshness
values.step: How recent the last sign of life of a DataChannel must be for it to carry Session frames and to spare a new offer; the sign is the traffic of the other end.

values.name: webrtc_reassembly
values.step: How long a message chunked over a DataChannel may take at the receiver between its first and its last chunk.
